result.instructions: One read-only tool: score_posting. Verdicts follow FILTER.md v1.0; INSUFFICIENT claims mean 'I cannot tell'.

tools.name: score_posting
tools.title: Score a job posting with Anisha's JS3 filter
tools.description: Scores ONE job posting for the fictional persona Nadia Okafor (entry-level data analyst, at most 3 years) with the rules in FILTER.md v1.0. Give either `id` (a posting id from the local corpus, e.g. 'greenhouse:stripe:123') or `title` + `text`. Returns the filter verdict (kept / rejected / cannot_tell), the score, the failed rules, and every justification claim labelled SUPPORTED / CONTRADICTED / INSUFFICIENT with a quote from the posting. Read-only: it does not fetch, apply, email or store anything.

id.description: posting id from the local corpus

location.description: optional; does not affect the verdict
